Form the rational sum with the integer-nanosecond remainder. float.as_integer_ratio gives exact numerators/denominators; cross-products verify the returned local deadline is no later than that rational bound. A failed finite/bound/expired check raises TimeoutError, never renews a budget.

Synthetic began is not the coordinator global begin and is never a resource epoch.
